blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse applied to Medical Devices & MedTech. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

items: MDR vigilance and performance data assembled manually; signal detection late.
Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Resilient, observable pipelines: trusted data from source to decision at SLA.
Lakehouse the right way: Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Decisions at event speed: sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Device telemetry + complaints into signal detection (surveillance proactive)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: EHR, imaging, genomics and claims on FHIR-native governed foundations with terminology services (cohort queries in minutes with lineage). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
